CustomField.description: Every applicable payment is recorded; complimentary bookings have their confirmation sent. Procurement ticks do not gate this status.
CustomField.formula: AND(NTE_Pricing_Ready__c, AND(IF(OR(NTE_Invoice_Required__c = "Yes", NTE_Listed_Price_Total__c > 0, NOT(NTE_Pricing_Ready__c)), NTE_Payment_Received__c, OR(NTE_Free_Space_Confirmed__c, NTE_Payment_Received__c)), OR(NOT(OR(NTE_Top_Up_Invoice_Required__c, BLANKVALUE(NTE_Top_Up_Staff_Total__c, 0) > 0)), NTE_Top_Up_Payment_Received__c)))
CustomField.label: NTE Payment Confirmed
